item.title: The Agentic Economy Doesn't Exist Yet
item.description: Fifty-one published definitions of the agentic economy. Zero convergence. Three historical analogs say definitions stabilize when infrastructure gets built, not when researchers agree.
item.author: noreply@agenticeconomy.dev (Rene Dechamps Otamendi)

item.title: What Is the Agentic Economy? Five Categories, Two Fault Lines
item.description: Fifty-one published definitions of the "Agentic Economy" do not mean the same thing. A taxonomy with five categories and two fault lines clarifies what the field actually looks like today.
item.author: noreply@agenticeconomy.dev (Rene Dechamps Otamendi)
